# 2 Baruch Chapter 66 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**66:1** "And-those-black-waters which-came-after-those-bright-waters and-darkened-them: these-are-the-deeds-of-those who-wickedly-followed-the-work-of-Jeroboam; and-these-are-the-deeds-of-those who-made-Judah-to-sin."

**66:2** "And-the-wicked deeds-of-Jehoiakim are-included-in-these-waters; and-of-those-like-him who-transgressed-the-law."

**66:3** "These-are-the-sixth-black-waters which-you-saw."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
